newsitem.title: GREECE: NO ACCORD WITH ERGOBANK SHAREHOLDERS-ALPHA CREDIT.
newsitem.headline: NO ACCORD WITH ERGOBANK SHAREHOLDERS-ALPHA CREDIT.

text.p: Hector Verykios, communications manager at private Alpha Credit Bank said there has been no exchange of block shares between Alpha Credit Bank and private ErgoBank and no accords between shareholders.
"There has been no exchange of block shares between Alpha Credit Bank and Ergobank and no agreements between shareholders," said Verykios.
There was market talk of an exchange of block shares between Alpha Credit Bank and Ergobank and an agreement between Alpha Credit Bank and major shareholders of private Ergobank last week.

Press reports over the weekend said Alpha Credit Bank aimed at acquiring a major stake at Ergobank via exchanges of block shares and accords between Alpha Credit Bank, major shareholders of Ergobank and mutual funds holding shares of Ergobank.
The top brass of Alpha Credit Bank was in a meeting and was not available for comment. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
